div.div: غَلَّانٌ (S, O, K) and ↓ غَالٌّ , (K,) applied to a camel, (S, O, K,) Thirsty: (K: *) or vehemently thirsty: (S, O, K: *) or affected with burning of the inside: (K: *) and ↓ غَالَّةٌ , and its pl. غَوَالُّ, camels not having fully satisfied their thirst. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
